text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! Next is uphill training runs, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Give me your orders. I shall 
do my best.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Quickly now, let us head to 
the uphill slope. ...You do want me to 
race, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall live up to your expectations. I 
will seize the crown of victory in any 
race. ...Now--!

"Exhausted from the race, Orfevre seems 
thoroughly irritated. It might be wise to 
reconsider her upcoming schedule."
